subject: general
question: As per the Monetary Policy Statement, 2025-26, the Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation for the financial year 2025-26 is projected at what percentage?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**4.0%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Monetary Policy Statement** is issued periodically by the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** to outline the economic and financial outlook for the country.
 
• The **Consumer Price Index (CPI)** measures the **average change in the prices of goods and services** consumed by households over time.
 
• For the financial year **2025-26**, the CPI inflation rate has been projected at **4%** based on current economic conditions and policy measures.
 
• The projection indicates the central bank’s focus on maintaining **price stability** while supporting economic growth.
 
• A **4% inflation rate** is considered within the target range set by the RBI under its **flexible inflation targeting framework** (2%-6%).
 
• This projection helps policymakers, investors, and businesses to plan their activities by providing a benchmark for expected price levels.
 
• Maintaining inflation near the target ensures the purchasing power of the currency remains stable, thereby fostering sustainable economic development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Consumer Price Index (CPI)** is an important economic indicator widely used for purposes such as:

 
 
• **Measuring inflation:** It reflects the rate at which the general level of prices is rising.
 
• **Policy formulation:** The RBI uses CPI data to design its **monetary policies**, including interest rate decisions.
 
• **Wage adjustments:** CPI is often used to adjust salaries and pensions to offset the impact of inflation.
 
 
 
• The **Monetary Policy Committee (MPC)**, a statutory body within the RBI, is responsible for setting the **inflation target** and adjusting key policy rates like the **repo rate** to achieve it.
 
• Other projections or data points in the Monetary Policy Statement typically include:
 
 
• **GDP growth rates,**
 
• **fiscal deficit trends,**
 
• and **global economic outlooks.**
